lens: conviction (PROTOCOL_V3 Addendum I): a stake per trade from what is known at the decision
data_rule: in sample only: price frames read with ts < 2022-01-01, official trades with entry_time < 2022-01-01, signals / chains of the context lens (in-sample tables); no 2022+ row read, simulated or looked at
account: plain sum of the ten sleeves' one-position chains (no caps, no compounding), 1 R x stake; the same throughout
weeks: FP server weeks (New York + 7 h, Monday-Sunday), booked at the exit; 157 out-of-fold weeks = those whose Thursday falls in 2019-2021 (Mondays 2018-12-31 .. 2021-12-27); every week counted
part1_note: terciles fitted on the baseline chain trades whose exit is at or before 1 January minus 7 days, applied to the next year's baseline chain trades; pooled = 2019 + 2020 + 2021; years_sign_as_training = years in which hi - lo had the sign of that year's training hi - lo; FP and costs x1.5 (part1.json has every year, the training statistics, and 2016-2018 reported apart)
part2_note: every variant of declared.json (V01-V28) and of declared_addendum.json (V29-V30, post hoc), FP and costs x1.5; ratio = pooled 2019-2021 weekly Sharpe / the reference's (equal swing changes no Sharpe); totals, losing weeks, worst week, longest losing run at equal weekly swing (k); losing trades per month over 36 months

part2_table.rule: every stake 1
per sleeve and fold year: among the eligible descriptors, the one with the largest |separation| (q = 1/3) on the training set; stakes by mapping_M with q = 1/3; no eligible descriptor -> stake 1

the four crypto breakouts (brk72_24h_wd btcusd / ethusd, F1_brk_ridge_filter btcusd / ethusd) pooled: per fold year, each eligible descriptor except rel2 is standardised per sleeve with that sleeve's training mean and sd (clipped to +/-4, NaN -> 0); y = training R clipped to [-2, 4]; y and z are demeaned within sleeve (= sleeve dummies); screening: the 6 descriptors with the largest |Pearson correlation| between z and y on the pooled training set; ridge on those 6, penalty alpha = 1.0 x n_train; score = beta . z; pooled training split of the score (q = 1/3); stakes: 'lo' = 0.5 (0 when that sleeve's training mean in its 'lo' group <= +0.02 R), 'mid' = 1, 'hi' = 1.5; the six other sleeves stake 1

verdict.closest: V05 (pooled crypto ridge): FP x1.095 (criterion (a) needs x1.10), up in 3 of 3 years, x1.102 and 3 of 3 with costs x1.5, every neighbour above the reference (x1.100 to x1.123), causal (210 of 210 decisions), (f) about 2.25 parameters per sleeve: NOT a candidate by the declared rule.
